claims: Repeat basic metabolic panel and whole blood potassium within 6 hours to reassess hyperkalemia (K 4.7-5.1 mEq/L) and metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 18-21 mEq/L, anion gap 15-19).
Trend lactate in 4-6 hours given elevated levels (3.0 → 2.3 → 2.1 mmol/L) to confirm resolution of hypoperfusion.
Continue continuous cardiac monitoring and telemetry for tachycardia (HR 106-117 bpm) and to monitor for arrhythmia in the setting of hyperkalemia and acidosis.
Continue heparin infusion with monitoring of aPTT and platelet count, given supratherapeutic PTT (114.5 sec) that improved to 25.3 sec and current INR 1.4-1.5.
Recheck coagulation panel (PT/INR, PTT) within 6-12 hours to ensure therapeutic anticoagulation and assess for bleeding risk.
Assess volume status and renal function with daily weights, strict intake/output, and repeat creatinine/BUN, given BUN 29-32 mg/dL and creatinine 0.9-1.0 mg/dL.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (9.3-9.4 g/dL, 29.2-30.4%) and assess for bleeding, with repeat CBC in 12-24 hours.
Perform delirium screening (CAM-ICU) each shift, noting prior positive MS change and current RASS +1, to guide non-pharmacologic and pharmacologic management.
Implement fall precautions and mobility assessment each shift given history of falls, use of walker, and current bedfast/chairfast status.
Maintain adequate nutrition and monitor Braden nutrition score (currently probably inadequate) with dietitian consultation as needed.
